text:
Maria (Marketing): Uploaded launch blog draft v3 to Drive — need a fast pass on a few things before we schedule publish: 1) hero benchmark claim copy, 2) localized CTAs (EN/DE/FR), 3) webinar demo seatmap + capacity, 4) inbound lead routing (HubSpot). Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/launch-draft-v3. Ideally get approvals by EOD today.
Sam (Growth): On it. I'll map HubSpot flows and inbound routing. Quick Q — are we gating the benchmark report or gating only the webinar?
Maria (Marketing): Gating the report download behind the webinar signup. Capture MQLs first, push to sales if org size >50 seats.
Josh (Product): Quick copy note on the hero: change '40% lower token cost' -> 'approximately 40% lower per-token inference cost' to avoid absolute wording. Add a short footnote about test workload (chat + 2k context).
Liz (Design): Updated hero visual and CTA variants in Figma: https://figma.com/file/updated-hero. Left two CTA options: 'Get the report' and 'See benchmarks'. Leaning toward 'See benchmarks' for intent alignment.
Sam (Growth): :thumbsup: 'See benchmarks' aligns better with discovery traffic. I'll wire the HubSpot form to that CTA and route leads to marketing@redwood.com + sales queue for enterprise.
Maria (Marketing): Demo capacity — @eng-ops can we host 500 concurrent attendees in our webinar platform? Need staging room + recording fallback plan.
DeployerBot: eng-ops scheduled load test: 2024-03-05 18:00 UTC — test ticket #4532.
Alex (Eng-Ops): We can support ~500 concurrent attendees, but recommend a second recording room and an overflow recording link. Also suggest one engineer on standby for live Q&A.
Maria (Marketing): Great — Alex, can you confirm the backup room and an engineer? If yes, we'll note that in the runbook.
Alex (Eng-Ops): Confirmed. Backup room reserved; assigning engineer on standby (ticket #4533).
Maria (Marketing): Localization — @lena can you quick-pass DE/FR CTAs + a small tone check? Keep it short.
Lena (Localization): On it. ETA ~4 hours. Small suggestion: DE CTA should be 'Benchmarks ansehen' rather than 'Berichte ansehen' for clarity.
Sam (Growth): Adding UTM params we should use: utm_campaign=launch_optimize; utm_source=blog; utm_medium=organic. Confirm?
Maria (Marketing): Confirmed. Use that structure for all CTAs.
Josh (Product): Legal check — we'll avoid absolute metrics without test context. Maria, ping legal once we finalize hero wording.
Maria (Marketing): Will do. Everyone please react with :white_check_mark: when you sign off so I can proceed to schedule publish + email send.
Liz (Design): :white_check_mark:
Sam (Growth): :white_check_mark:
Josh (Product): :white_check_mark:
Alex (Eng-Ops): :white_check_mark:
Lena (Localization): :white_check_mark: (will add a short note in the doc)
DeployerBot: Reminder — add final hero claim to PR for legal review (cc: legal@redwood.com).
Maria (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll merge after legal quick-pass and then schedule the publish + webinar invite. If anything blocks, ping here.
